lifecycle: LIFECYCLE NRND: W25Q64JVxIQ (U30) is not recommended for new designs by its vendor (Winbond Parts Catalog export winbond-W25Q64JV-catalog-export-2026-11-16.csv exported by Scotty 2026-11-16, column 15 Status-Industrial = N for all 16 xIQ codes (legend N = Not Recommended for New Design, relayed: not in the export); SSIQ screenshots 73aa6c75 (N) and 7091ccdc (Longevity Y since 2016/03); DigiKey: Active (not held)), acknowledged in accept_lifecycle
capacitance: upper bound estimated from routed geometry
conditions: scope: the bare board's copper and each I2C pin's Ci; part bodies, solder and terminations above the pads are not included
laminate and solder mask relative permittivity at most 5.4 (the IPC-4101 FR-4 maximum, specified at 1 MHz)
finished copper at most 70 um thick; finished board from 0.34 mm to 2.0 mm thick
zone fill keeps the board's clearance (the DRC gate refills and judges it)
every I2C pin at most UM10204's Ci of 10 pF; no multiplexer or switch on the line
neighbouring nets are static while the line rises

on SCK and MOSI, each device pin not counted at a declared value at its part's cited maximum pin capacitance (parts table); the MCU's own pin drives the line and is not counted (DS12117 Table 149's C is the external load)

U40 (ICM42688P): each of its pins on a bounded line counted at 10000 fF, a value the specification declares, not a maximum the datasheet prints; the bound holds only under its condition: each of U40's pins on SCK and MOSI at most TDK's typical C_I of < 10 pF; the datasheet prints no maximum, so the bound holds only if the part's pins do not exceed that typical (source: TDK InvenSense DS-000347 v1.9, 3.3.2 Table 4, p. 14: C_I < 10 pF for FSYNC, SCLK, SDI and CS in the TYP column, MIN and MAX empty (AET-WO-4220 D10))
